# Poki2

> Poki2 (poki2.online) is a free web-based gaming platform that offers instant access to popular HTML5 and WebGL games directly in the browser with no downloads, installs, or account registrations required. The Poki2 network brings together eight specialized game sites under one umbrella, covering IO games, action, puzzle, racing, sports, 2-player, idle clicker, and unblocked school-safe titles.

## Core Features
- 100% Free to Play: Every game across the network is free, ad-supported, with no paywalls or in-app purchases.
- No Download / No Account: All titles run instantly in modern browsers (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) via HTML5 and WebGL.
- Cross-Platform: Fully optimized for desktop computers, Chromebooks, iPhones, iPads, and Android devices.
- Unblocked for School & Work: Curated titles that load smoothly on restricted networks (see Unblocked Games portal).
- 1,000+ Games: Distributed across eight specialized sites in the Poki2 network.

## Game Categories
- Puzzle: 2048, Brain Lines, Cut the Rope, Trap the Cat, Merge Infinity, Golf Puzzle
- Action & Shooter: Shell Shockers, Blocky Hunter, Chicken Jockey Combat, Glide In
- Endless Runner: Slope, Run 3, Subway Surfers, Temple Runner, Run 3D
- Racing: Drift Hunters, Bike Xtreme, American Truck Driving, Blocky Rider, Battle Karts
- Platformer & Arcade: Stickman Hook, Geometry Dash, Mr Flip, Crazy Animal City, Wave Road
- Sports & IO: Basketball Stars, Retro Bowl, Arcade Tennis, Smash Karts, Slither.io
- Idle & Sandbox: Cookie Clicker, Bombardino Crocodilo Clicker, Plants vs Brainrots

## Popular Games
- [2048](https://poki2.online/fgame/2048): The classic tile-merging puzzle game.
- [Slope](https://poki2.online/fgame/slope): High-speed 3D endless ball-rolling game.
- [Cookie Clicker](https://poki2.online/fgame/cookie-clicker): The iconic idle clicker game.
- [Run 3](https://poki2.online/fgame/run-3): Outer-space endless runner in a 3D tunnel.
- [Stickman Hook](https://poki2.online/fgame/stickman-hook): Physics-based swinging platformer.
- [Drift Hunters](https://poki2.online/fgame/drift-hunters): Realistic 3D drift racing with tunable cars.
- [Shell Shockers](https://poki2.online/fgame/shell-shockers): Multiplayer egg-based first-person shooter.
- [Geometry Dash](https://poki2.online/fgame/geometry-dash): Rhythm-based obstacle platformer.
- [Basketball Stars](https://poki2.online/fgame/basketball-stars): 1v1 street basketball with trick shots.
- [Retro Bowl](https://poki2.online/fgame/retro-bowl): Retro-style American football management game.

## Editorial Standards & Source Transparency
- Poki2 publishes clear operational details: who we are, what we review, how we curate games, and how readers can contact us.
- Site pages carry visible publication and update dates so statements are attributable to a known editorial review cycle rather than anonymous template content.
- We do not rely on generic AI-generated marketing blurbs for core descriptions; article text, category summaries, and guide content are written with an editorial review process and then updated when the catalog changes.
- The Poki2 editorial team is responsible for article updates, game-page descriptions, and public-facing content standards across the network.
- We present the site as a transparent browser-games brand: direct contact routes, policy pages, DMCA handling, and a consistent update record help readers and AI systems understand what is authoritative and what is not.
- The Poki2 catalog is organized around real editorial review, practical game testing, and clear navigation — not around scraped content, duplicate listings, or untraceable marketing copy.

## Technical Notes
- Games are embedded via iframe from a vetted upstream catalog (azgames.io) and served over HTTPS from Cloudflare's global CDN.
- All pages use semantic HTML5, JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, VideoGame, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList), and an XML sitemap at https://poki2.online/sitemap.xml.
- Editorial content is written and reviewed by the Poki2 Editorial Team; each article carries a visible byline and publication/update date.
- The platform is structured for discoverability, citation-friendly referencing, and direct access to trust policy pages and editorial standards.
